objective: Recover slow-network Community Wall photos without mistaking slow downloads for missing images

acceptanceChecks: Slow photo request cannot unmount image solely after 20 seconds
Photo loader removes overlay on successful onLoad as well as onDisplay
Photo signing has bounded 12s timeout and short retry cooldown for transient errors
Missing or unauthorized storage objects retain longer negative cache
Existing signing dedupe, RLS and cache protections preserved
No native build, DB mutation or unrelated modules
Already cached durable-path photos render without a new signed URL; uncached sign failures receive only one automatic retry
Android Metro selects the dedicated direct-sized .android.tsx photo component while web keeps its existing .tsx renderer
If expo-image cannot complete after 8 seconds, use React Native Image with the same signed URL; never request public media or spin indefinitely
No opaque media mask; Android onLoad preserves collage sizing; one re-sign and manual retry are bounded
